scope: reset-only minimum-renderer development; not production or full M2 admission
authority: Founder conditional approval of end-exclusive $9000; M2 Extended Resident Profile and Xemu Admission
physical_owner: CoreRuntime bank zero; no change of owner
application_map_policy: canonical zero offsets/megabytes only; no temporary MAP in this executable
staging_policy: own initial PRG load is permitted; no later loading or staging over any resident byte, including the extension
boot_trap: existing reset-only CF001 ROM-protection trap suspends application in privileged Hypervisor space; no application code or resident-data access until exact canonical state is restored; no application MAP lease
cartridge_policy: Platform clears CARTEN and forces inactive GAME/EXROM with POWEREN retained; Xemu no-cartridge configuration required; physical behavior is not emulator evidence
entry_policy: fresh direct-PRG BASIC entry only; canonicalize before dependent accesses; no external NMI before private vectors are installed; arbitrary inherited or physical entry is not admitted
scratch_initialization: zero complete linked .noinit before BSS initialization; do not include it in PRG payload claims
admission: complete linked fit, startup/visibility, whole-program stacks, interrupt/fault and renderer service must pass before direct-PRG PAL/NTSC Xemu
